name: 人工繁殖催产激素剂量配比器

map.按鱼种与亲鱼体重计算催产激素剂量，并给出分针方案与效应时间: Compute induced-spawning hormone dosage for fish artificial breeding.
map.📖 查看「亲鱼催产激素剂量计算（两针法）使用指南」: 📖 View the "Broodstock Spawning Hormone Dose (Two-Injection Method) Guide"
map.四大家鱼（青草鲢鳙）: Four major Chinese carps (black, grass, silver, bighead)
map.剂量参考水产繁殖常用方案：LRH-A 10-20 μg/kg、DOM 5-10: Doses follow common aquaculture breeding protocols: LRH-A 10-20 μg/kg, DOM 5-10 mg/kg, HCG 800-1500 IU/kg; injections: first 10-20%, second 80-90% (8-12 h apart); the response time shortens as water temperature rises, about 10-16 h. Halve the dose for males.
map.📚 深度解析：亲鱼催产激素剂量计算（两针法）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Broodstock Spawning Hormone Dose (Two-Injection Method)
map.按雌鱼总重与单尾剂量计算催产剂（LRH-A、DOM 等）总量，并拆分第一针 15: From the total weight of the females and the per-fish dose, compute the total amount of spawning agent (LRH-A, DOM and so on) and split it into 15% for the first injection and 85% for the second.
map.根据水温估算效应时间（两针后至产卵间隔）与两针间隔。: Estimate the response time (from the second injection to spawning) and the interval between injections from the water temperature.
map.雄鱼剂量通常减半，并在雌鱼第二针时注射。: Males are usually given half the dose, injected at the time of the females' second injection.
map.雌鱼 50 kg 的催产剂配制: Preparing the spawning agent for 50 kg of females
map.默认参数：雌鱼总重 50 kg，单尾 LRH-A 75 μg、DOM 35 mg: With the default parameters: 50 kg of females, 75 μg LRH-A and 35 mg DOM per fish; totals of 750 μg LRH-A and 350 mg DOM; first injection 15% (LRH-A 112.5 μg, DOM 52.5 mg) and second injection 85% (LRH-A 637.5 μg, DOM 297.5 mg); the injections are about 10 h apart and spawning occurs about 10.8 h after the second (faster at higher water temperature); the male dose is halved (LRH-A 37.5 μg, DOM 17.5 mg per fish).
map.为什么分两针？: Why split the dose into two injections?
map.两针法让亲鱼有发情与排卵准备时间，提高受精率与产卵同步性。: The two-injection method gives the broodstock time to prepare for oestrus and ovulation, improving the fertilisation rate and spawning synchrony.
map.剂量能直接套用吗？: Can the dose be applied directly?
map.需结合亲鱼性腺成熟度、品种与水温微调，本工具给出基础核算，实际请遵医嘱与技术规范: Adjust it with the gonad maturity of the broodstock, the species and the water temperature; this tool gives a basic calculation, and in practice follow veterinary advice and technical standards.
map.人工繁殖催产激素剂量配比器 - 按鱼种与体重计算催产激素（HCG/LRH-A/D: Induced Spawning Hormone Dose Calculator - computes the dose of spawning hormones (HCG / LRH-A / DOM) and the split-injection plan from the species and body weight, an online fishery and aquaculture tool. A fishery and aquaculture tool that helps calculate farming parameters and yields.
